look_here_first: Low fine-textured woodland sedge with narrow V-shaped leaves and small separate spikes, especially common on calcareous soils beneath juniper and oak.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Carex sedges have sheathing leaves and perigynia enclosing the fruits.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: young blades V-shaped in cross section

lookalikes.differences: Lower and finer-textured than C. edwardsiana; much smaller and drier-site than C. emoryi or C. crus-corvi.
